σαβαχθανι.def: of Chaldee or (H7662 with pronominal suffix); thou hast left me; sabachthani (i.e. shebakthani), a cry of distress. KJV: sabachthani.

σαβαωθ.def: of Hebrew origin (H6635 in feminine plural); armies; sabaoth (i.e. tsebaoth), a military epithet of God. KJV: sabaoth.

σαββατισμοσ.def: from a derivative of σάββατον (G4521); a "sabbatism", i.e. (figuratively) the repose of Christianity (as a type of heaven). KJV: rest.

σαββατον.def: of Hebrew origin (H7676); the Sabbath (i.e. Shabbath), or day of weekly repose from secular avocations (also the observance or institution itself); by extension, a se'nnight, i.e. the interval between two Sabbaths; likewise the plural in all the above applications. KJV: sabbath (day), week.

σαγηνη.def: from a derivative of σάττω (to equip) meaning furniture, especially a pack-saddle (which in the East is merely a bag of netted rope); a "seine" for fishing. KJV: net.

σαδδουκαιοσ.def: probably from Σαδώκ (G4524); a Sadducæan (i.e. Tsadokian), or follower of a certain heretical Israelite. KJV: Sadducee.

σαδωκ.def: of Hebrew origin (H6659); Sadoc (i.e. Tsadok), an Israelite. KJV: Sadoc.

σαινω.def: akin to σείω (G4579); to wag (as a dog its tail fawningly), i.e. (generally) to shake (figuratively, disturb). KJV: move.

σακκοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8242); "sack"-cloth, i.e. mohair (the material or garments made of it, worn as a sign of grief). KJV: sackcloth.

σαλα.def: of Hebrew origin (H7974); Sala (i.e. Shelach), a patriarch. KJV: Sala.

σαλαθιηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7597); Salathiel (i.e. Shealtiel), an Israelite. KJV: Salathiel.

σαλαμισ.def: probably from σάλος (G4535) (from the surge on the shore); Salamis, a place in Cyprus. KJV: Salamis.

σαλειμ.def: probably from the same as σαλεύω (G4531); Salim, a place in Palestine. KJV: Salim.

σαλευω.def: from σάλος (G4535); to waver, i.e. agitate, rock, topple or (by implication) destroy; figuratively, to disturb, incite. KJV: move, shake (together), which can(-not) be shaken, stir up.

σαλημ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8004); Salem (i.e. Shalem), a place in Palestine. KJV: Salem.

σαλμων.def: of Hebrew origin (H8012); Salmon, an Israelite. KJV: Salmon.

σαλμωνη.def: perhaps of similar origin to Σαλαμίς (G4529); Salmone, a place in Crete. KJV: Salmone.

σαλοσ.def: probably from the base of σαίνω (G4525); a vibration, i.e. (specially), billow. KJV: wave.

σαλπιγξ.def: perhaps from σάλος (G4535) (through the idea of quavering or reverberation); a trumpet. KJV: trump(-et).

σαλπιζω.def: from σάλπιγξ (G4536); to trumpet, i.e. sound a blast (literally or figuratively). KJV: (which are yet to) sound (a trumpet).

σαλπιστησ.def: from σαλπίζω (G4537); a trumpeter. KJV: trumpeter.

σαλωμη.def: probably of Hebrew origin (feminine from H7965); Salome (i.e. Shelomah), an Israelitess. KJV: Salome.

σαμαρεια.def: of Hebrew origin (H8111); Samaria (i.e. Shomeron), a city and region of Palestine. KJV: Samaria.

σαμαρειτησ.def: from Σαμάρεια (G4540); a Samarite, i.e. inhabitant of Samaria. KJV: Samaritan.

σαμαρειτισ.def: feminine of Σαμαρείτης (G4541); a Samaritess, i.e. woman of Samaria. KJV: of Samaria.

σαμοθρακη.def: from Σάμος (G4544) and Θτρᾴκη (Thrace); Samo-thrace (Samos of Thrace), an island in the Mediterranean. KJV: Samothracia.

σαμοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; Samus, an island of the Mediterranean. KJV: Samos.

σαμουηλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8050); Samuel (i.e. Shemuel), an Israelite. KJV: Samuel.

σαμψων.def: of Hebrew origin (H8123); Sampson (i.e. Shimshon), an Israelite. KJV: Samson.

σανδαλιον.def: neuter of a derivative of σάνδαλον (a "sandal"; of uncertain origin); a slipper or sole-pad. KJV: sandal.

σανισ.def: of uncertain affinity; a plank. KJV: board.

σαουλ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7586); Saul (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul. KJV: Saul.

σαπροσ.def: from σήπω (G4595); rotten, i.e. worthless (literally or morally). KJV: bad, corrupt.

σαπφειρη.def: feminine of σάπφειρος (G4552); Sapphire, an Israelitess. KJV: Sapphira.

σαπφειροσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H5601); a "sapphire" or lapis-lazuli gem. KJV: sapphire.

σαργανη.def: apparently of Hebrew origin (H8276); a basket (as interwoven or wicker-work. KJV: basket.

σαρδεισ.def: plural of uncertain derivation; Sardis, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Sardis.

σαρδινοσ.def: from the same as σάρδιος (G4556); sardine (λίθος (G3037) being implied), i.e. a gem, so called. KJV: sardine.

σαρδιοσ.def: properly, an adjective from an uncertain base; sardian (3037 being implied), i.e. (as noun) the gem so called. KJV: sardius.

σαρδονυξ.def: from the base of σάρδιος (G4556) and ὄνυξ (the nail of a finger; hence the "onyx" stone); a "sardonyx", i.e. the gem so called. KJV: sardonyx.

σαρεπτα.def: of Hebrew origin (H6886); Sarepta (i.e. Tsarephath), a place in Palestine. KJV: Sarepta.

σαρκικοσ.def: from σάρξ (G4561); pertaining to flesh, i.e. (by extension) bodily, temporal, or (by implication) animal, unregenerate. KJV: carnal, fleshly.

σαρκινοσ.def: from σάρξ (G4561); similar to flesh, i.e. (by analogy) soft. KJV: fleshly.

σαρξ.def: probably from the base of σαρόω (G4563); flesh (as stripped of the skin), i.e. (strictly) the meat of an animal (as food), or (by extension) the body (as opposed to the soul (or spirit), or as the symbol of what is external, or as the means of kindred), or (by implication) human nature (with its frailties (physically or morally) and passions), or (specially), a human being (as such). KJV: carnal(-ly, + -ly minded), flesh(-ly).

σαρουχ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8286); Saruch (i.e. Serug), a patriarch. KJV: Saruch.

σαροω.def: from a derivative of σαίρω (to brush off; akin to σύρω (G4951)); meaning a broom; to sweep. KJV: sweep.

σαρρα.def: of Hebrew origin (H8283); Sarra (i.e. Sarah), the wife of Abraham. KJV: Sara, Sarah.

σαρων.def: of Hebrew origin (H8289); Saron (i.e. Sharon), a district of Palestine. KJV: Saron.

σαταν.def: of Hebrew origin (H7854); Satan, i.e. the devil. KJV: Satan.

σατανασ.def: of Chaldee origin corresponding to H4566 (with the definite affix); the accuser, i.e. the devil. KJV: Satan.

σατον.def: of Hebrew origin (H5429); a certain measure for things dry. KJV: measure.

σαυλοσ.def: of Hebrew origin, the same as Σαούλ (G4549); Saulus (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul. KJV: Saul.

σβεννυμι.def: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb; to extinguish (literally or figuratively). KJV: go out, quench.

σε.def: accusative case singular of σύ (G4771); thee. KJV: thee, thou, X thy house.

σεαυτου.def: genitive case from σέ (G4571) and αὐτός (G846), also dative case of the same, σεαυτῷ, and accusative case σεαυτόν, likewise contracted σαυτοῦ, σαυτῷ, and σαυτόν, respectively; of (with, to) thyself. KJV: thee, thine own self, (thou) thy(-self).

σεβαζομαι.def: middle voice from a derivative of σέβομαι (G4576); to venerate, i.e. adore. KJV: worship.

σεβασμα.def: from σεβάζομαι (G4573); something adored, i.e. an object of worship (god, altar, etc). KJV: devotion, that is worshipped.

σεβαστοσ.def: from σεβάζομαι (G4573); venerable (august), i.e. (as noun) a title of the Roman Emperor, or (as adjective) imperial. KJV: Augustus(-').

σεβομαι.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to revere, i.e. adore. KJV: devout, religious, worship.

σειρα.def: probably from σύρω (G4951) through its congener εἴρω (to fasten; akin to αἱρέομαι (G138)); a chain (as binding or drawing). KJV: chain.

σεισμοσ.def: from σείω (G4579); a commotion, i.e. (of the air) a gale, (of the ground) an earthquake. KJV: earthquake, tempest.

σειω.def: apparently a primary verb; to rock (vibrate, properly, sideways or to and fro), i.e. (generally) to agitate (in any direction; cause to tremble); figuratively, to throw into a tremor (of fear or concern). KJV: move, quake, shake.

σεκουνδοσ.def: of Latin origin; "second"; Secundus, a Christian. KJV: Secundus.

σελευκεια.def: from Σέλευκος (Seleucus, a Syrian king); Seleuceia, a place in Syria. KJV: Seleucia.

σεληνη.def: from σέλας (brilliancy; probably akin to the alternate of αἱρέομαι (G138), through the idea of attractiveness); the moon. KJV: moon.

σεληνιαζομαι.def: middle voice or passive from a presumed derivative of σελήνη (G4582); to be moon-struck, i.e. crazy. KJV: be a lunatic.

σεμει.def: of Hebrew origin (H8096); Semei (i.e. Shimi), an Israelite. KJV: Semei.

σεμιδαλισ.def: probably of foreign origin; fine wheaten flour. KJV: fine flour.

σεμνοσ.def: from σέβομαι (G4576); venerable, i.e. honorable. KJV: grave, honest.

σεμνοτησ.def: from σεμνός (G4586); venerableness, i.e. probity. KJV: gravity, honesty.

σεργιοσ.def: of Latin origin; Sergius, a Roman. KJV: Sergius.

σηθ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8352); Seth (i.e. Sheth), a patriarch. KJV: Seth.

σημ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8035); Sem (i.e. Shem), a patriarch. KJV: Sem.

σημαινω.def: from σῆμα (a mark; of uncertain derivation); to indicate. KJV: signify.

σημειον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of σημαίνω (G4591); an indication, especially ceremonially or supernaturally. KJV: miracle, sign, token, wonder.

σημειοω.def: from σημεῖον (G4592); to distinguish, i.e. mark (for avoidance). KJV: note.

σημερον.def: neuter (as adverb) of a presumed compound of the article ὁ (G3588) (t changed to s) and ἡμέρα (G2250); on the (i.e. this) day (or night current or just passed); generally, now (i.e. at present, hitherto). KJV: this (to-)day.

σηπω.def: apparently a primary verb; to putrefy, i.e. (figuratively) perish. KJV: be corrupted.

σηρικοσ.def: from Σήρ (an Indian tribe from whom silk was procured; hence the name of the silk-worm); Seric, i.e. silken (neuter as noun, a silky fabric). KJV: silk.

σησ.def: apparently of Hebrew origin (H5580); a moth. KJV: moth.

σητοβρωτοσ.def: from σής (G4597) and a derivative of βιβρώσκω (G977); moth-eaten. KJV: motheaten.

σθενοω.def: from σθένος (bodily vigor; probably akin to the base of ἵστημι (G2476)); to strengthen, i.e. (figuratively) confirm (in spiritual knowledge and power). KJV: strengthen.

σιαγων.def: of uncertain derivation; the jaw-bone, i.e. (by implication) the cheek or side of the face. KJV: cheek.

σιγαω.def: from σιγή (G4602); to keep silent (transitively or intransitively). KJV: keep close (secret, silence), hold peace.

σιγη.def: apparently from σίζω (to hiss, i.e. hist or hush); silence. KJV: silence.

σιδηρεοσ.def: from σίδηρος (G4604); made of iron. KJV: (of) iron.

σιδηροσ.def: of uncertain derivation; iron. KJV: iron.

σιδων.def: of Hebrew origin (H6721); Sidon (i.e. Tsidon), a place in Palestine. KJV: Sidon.

σιδωνιοσ.def: from Σιδών (G4605); a Sidonian, i.e. inhabitant of Sidon. KJV: of Sidon.

σικαριοσ.def: of Latin origin; a dagger-man or assassin; a freebooter (Jewish fanatic outlawed by the Romans). KJV: murderer.

σικερα.def: of Hebrew origin (H7941); an intoxicant, i.e. intensely fermented liquor. KJV: strong drink.

σιλασ.def: contraction for Σιλουανός (G4610); Silas, a Christian. KJV: Silas.

σιλουανοσ.def: of Latin origin; "silvan"; Silvanus, a Christian. KJV: Silvanus.

σιλωαμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7975); Siloam (i.e. Shiloach), a pool of Jerusalem. KJV: Siloam.

σιμικινθιον.def: of Latin origin; a semicinctium or half-girding, i.e. narrow covering (apron). KJV: apron.

σιμων.def: of Hebrew origin (H8095); Simon (i.e. Shimon), the name of nine Israelites. KJV: Simon.

σινα.def: of Hebrew origin (H5514); Sina (i.e. Sinai), a mountain in Arabia. KJV: Sina.

σιναπι.def: perhaps from σίνομαι (to hurt, i.e. sting); mustard (the plant). KJV: mustard.

σινδων.def: of uncertain (perhaps foreign) origin; byssos, i.e. bleached linen (the cloth or a garment of it). KJV: (fine) linen (cloth).

σινιαζω.def: from σινίον (a sieve); to riddle (figuratively). KJV: sift.

σιτευτοσ.def: from a derivative of σῖτος (G4621); grain-fed, i.e. fattened. KJV: fatted.

σιτιστοσ.def: from a derivative of σῖτος (G4621); grained, i.e. fatted. KJV: fatling.

σιτομετρον.def: from σῖτος (G4621) and μέτρον (G3358); a grain-measure, i.e. (by implication) ration (allowance of food). KJV: portion of meat.

σιτοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; grain, especially wheat. KJV: corn, wheat.

σιων.def: of Hebrew origin (H6726); Sion (i.e. Tsijon), a hill of Jerusalem; figuratively, the Church (militant or triumphant). KJV: Sion.

σιωπαω.def: from σιωπή (silence, i.e. a hush; properly, muteness, i.e. involuntary stillness, or inability to speak; and thus differing from σιγή (G4602), which is rather a voluntary refusal or indisposition to speak, although the terms are often used synonymously); to be dumb (but not deaf also, like 2974 properly); figuratively, to be calm (as quiet water). KJV: dumb, (hold) peace.

σκανδαλιζω.def: from σκάνδαλον (G4625); to entrap, i.e. trip up (figuratively, stumble (transitively) or entice to sin, apostasy or displeasure). KJV: (make to) offend.

σκανδαλον.def: ("scandal"); probably from a derivative of κάμπτω (G2578); a trap-stick (bent sapling), i.e. snare (figuratively, cause of displeasure or sin). KJV: occasion to fall (of stumbling), offence, thing that offends, stumblingblock.

σκαπτω.def: apparently a primary verb; to dig. KJV: dig.

σκαφη.def: a "skiff" (as if dug out), or yawl (carried aboard a large vessel for landing). KJV: boat.

σκελοσ.def: apparently from σκέλλω (to parch; through the idea of leanness); the leg (as lank). KJV: leg.

σκεπασμα.def: from a derivative of σκέπας (a covering; perhaps akin to the base of σκοπός (G4649) through the idea of noticeableness); clothing. KJV: raiment.

σκευασ.def: apparently of Latin origin; left-handed; Scevas (i.e. Scævus), an Israelite. KJV: Sceva.

σκευη.def: from σκεῦος (G4632); furniture, i.e. spare tackle. KJV: tackling.

σκευοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a vessel, implement, equipment or apparatus (literally or figuratively [specially, a wife as contributing to the usefulness of the husband]). KJV: goods, sail, stuff, vessel.

σκηνη.def: apparently akin to σκεῦος (G4632) and σκιά (G4639); a tent or cloth hut (literally or figuratively). KJV: habitation, tabernacle.

σκηνοπηγια.def: from σκῆνος (G4636) and πήγνυμι (G4078); the Festival of Tabernacles (so called from the custom of erecting booths for temporary homes). KJV: tabernacles.

σκηνοποιοσ.def: from σκηνή (G4633) and ποιέω (G4160); a manufacturer of tents. KJV: tent-maker.

σκηνοσ.def: from σκηνή (G4633); a hut or temporary residence, i.e. (figuratively) the human body (as the abode of the spirit). KJV: tabernacle.

σκηνοω.def: from σκῆνος (G4636); to tent or encamp, i.e. (figuratively) to occupy (as a mansion) or (specially), to reside (as God did in the Tabernacle of old, a symbol of protection and communion). KJV: dwell.

σκηνωμα.def: from σκηνόω (G4637); an encampment, i.e. (figuratively) the Temple (as God's residence), the body (as a tenement for the soul). KJV: tabernacle.

σκια.def: apparently a primary word; "shade" or a shadow (literally or figuratively (darkness of error or an adumbration)). KJV: shadow.

σκιρταω.def: akin to σκαίρω (to skip); to jump, i.e. sympathetically move (as the quickening of a fetus). KJV: leap (for joy).

σκληροκαρδια.def: feminine of a compound of σκληρός (G4642) and καρδία (G2588); hard-heartedness, i.e. (specially), destitution of (spiritual) perception. KJV: hardness of heart.

σκληροσ.def: from the base of σκέλος (G4628); dry, i.e. hard or tough (figuratively, harsh, severe). KJV: fierce, hard.

σκληροτησ.def: from σκληρός (G4642); callousness, i.e. (figuratively) stubbornness. KJV: hardness.

σκληροτραχηλοσ.def: from σκληρός (G4642) and τράχηλος (G5137); hardnaped, i.e. (figuratively) obstinate. KJV: stiffnecked.

σκληρυνω.def: from σκληρός (G4642); to indurate, i.e. (figuratively) render stubborn. KJV: harden.

σκολιοσ.def: from the base of σκέλος (G4628); warped, i.e. winding; figuratively, perverse. KJV: crooked, froward, untoward.

σκολοψ.def: perhaps from the base of σκέλος (G4628) and ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); withered at the front, i.e. a point or prickle (figuratively, a bodily annoyance or disability). KJV: thorn.

σκοπεω.def: from σκοπός (G4649); to take aim at (spy), i.e. (figuratively) regard. KJV: consider, take heed, look at (on), mark.

σκοποσ.def: from σκέπτομαι (to peer about ("skeptic"); perhaps akin to σκάπτω (G4626) through the idea of concealment; compare σκέπασμα (G4629)); a watch (sentry or scout), i.e. (by implication) a goal. KJV: mark.

σκορπιζω.def: apparently from the same as σκορπίος (G4651) (through the idea of penetrating); to dissipate, i.e. (figuratively) put to flight, waste, be liberal. KJV: disperse abroad, scatter (abroad).

σκορπιοσ.def: probably from an obsolete σκέρπω (perhaps strengthened from the base of σκοπός (G4649) and meaning to pierce); a "scorpion" (from its sting). KJV: scorpion.

σκοτεινοσ.def: from σκότος (G4655); opaque, i.e. (figuratively) benighted. KJV: dark, full of darkness.

σκοτια.def: from σκότος (G4655); dimness, obscurity (literally or figuratively). KJV: dark(-ness).

σκοτιζω.def: from σκότος (G4655); to obscure (literally or figuratively). KJV: darken.

σκοτοσ.def: from the base of σκιά (G4639); shadiness, i.e. obscurity (literally or figuratively). KJV: darkness.

σκοτοω.def: from σκότος (G4655); to obscure or blind (literally or figuratively). KJV: be full of darkness.

σκυβαλον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of εἰς (G1519) and κύων (G2965) and βάλλω (G906); what is thrown to the dogs, i.e. refuse (ordure). KJV: dung.

σκυθησ.def: probably of foreign origin; a Scythene or Scythian, i.e. (by implication) a savage. KJV: Scythian.

σκυθρωποσ.def: from σκυθρός (sullen) and a derivative of ὀπτάνομαι (G3700); angry-visaged, i.e. gloomy or affecting a mournful appearance. KJV: of a sad countenance.

σκυλλω.def: apparently a primary verb; to flay, i.e. (figuratively) to harass. KJV: trouble(self).

σκυλον.def: neuter from σκύλλω (G4660); something stripped (as a hide), i.e. booty. KJV: spoil.

σκωληκοβρωτοσ.def: from σκώληξ (G4663) and a derivative of βιβρώσκω (G977); worm-eaten, i.e. diseased with maggots. KJV: eaten of worms.

σκωληξ.def: of uncertain derivation; a grub, maggot or earth-worm. KJV: worm.

σμαραγδινοσ.def: from σμάραγδος (G4665); consisting of emerald. KJV: emerald.

σμαραγδοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; the emerald or green gem so called. KJV: emerald.

σμυρνα.def: apparently strengthened for μύρον (G3464); myrrh. KJV: myrrh.
the same as σμύρνα (G4666); Smyrna, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Smyrna.

σμυρναιοσ.def: from Σμύρνα (G4667); a Smyrnæan. KJV: in Smyrna.

σμυρνιζω.def: from Σμύρνα (G4667); to tincture with myrrh, i.e. embitter (as a narcotic). KJV: mingle with myrrh.

σοδομα.def: plural of Hebrew origin (H5467); Sodoma (i.e. Sedom), a place in Palestine. KJV: Sodom.

σοι.def: dative case of σύ (G4771); to thee. KJV: thee, thine own, thou, thy.

σολομων.def: of Hebrew origin (H8010); Solomon (i.e. Shelomoh), the son of David. KJV: Solomon.

σοροσ.def: probably akin to the base of σωρεύω (G4987); a funereal receptacle (urn, coffin), i.e. (by analogy) a bier. KJV: bier.

σοσ.def: from σύ (G4771); thine. KJV: thine (own), thy (friend).

σου.def: genitive case of σύ (G4771); of thee, thy. KJV: X home, thee, thine (own), thou, thy.

σουδαριον.def: of Latin origin; a sudarium (sweat-cloth), i.e. towel (for wiping the perspiration from the face, or binding the face of a corpse). KJV: handkerchief, napkin.

σουσαννα.def: of Hebrew origin (H7799 feminine); lily; Susannah (i.e. Shoshannah), an Israelitess. KJV: Susanna.

σοφια.def: from σοφός (G4680); wisdom (higher or lower, worldly or spiritual). KJV: wisdom.

σοφιζω.def: from σοφός (G4680); to render wise; in a sinister acceptation, to form "sophisms", i.e. continue plausible error. KJV: cunningly devised, make wise.

σοφοσ.def: akin to σαφής (clear); wise (in a most general application). KJV: wise.

σπανια.def: probably of foreign origin; Spania, a region of Europe. KJV: Spain.

σπαρασσω.def: prolongation from σπαίρω (to grasp; apparently strengthened from σπάω (G4685) through the idea of spasmodic contraction); to mangle, i.e. convluse with epilepsy. KJV: rend, tear.

σπαργανοω.def: from σπάργανον (a strip; from a derivative of the base of σπαράσσω (G4682) meaning to strap or wrap with strips); to swathe (an infant after the Oriental custom). KJV: wrap in swaddling clothes.

σπαταλαω.def: from σπατάλη (luxury); to be voluptuous. KJV: live in pleasure, be wanton.

σπαω.def: a primary verb; to draw. KJV: draw (out).

σπειρα.def: of immediate Latin origin, but ultimately a derivative of αἱρέομαι (G138) in the sense of its cognate εἱλίσσω (G1507); a coil (spira, "spire"), i.e. (figuratively) a mass of men (a Roman military cohort; also (by analogy) a squad of Levitical janitors). KJV: band.

σπειρω.def: probably strengthened from σπάω (G4685) (through the idea of extending); to scatter, i.e. sow (literally or figuratively). KJV: sow(- er), receive seed.

σπεκουλατωρ.def: of Latin origin; a speculator, i.e. military scout (spy or (by extension) life-guardsman). KJV: executioner.

σπενδω.def: apparently a primary verb; to pour out as a libation, i.e. (figuratively) to devote (one's life or blood, as a sacrifice) ("spend"). KJV: (be ready to) be offered.

σπερμα.def: from σπείρω (G4687); something sown, i.e. seed (including the male "sperm"); by implication, offspring; specially, a remnant (figuratively, as if kept over for planting). KJV: issue, seed.

σπερμολογοσ.def: from σπέρμα (G4690) and λέγω (G3004); a seed-picker (as the crow), i.e. (figuratively) a sponger, loafer (specially, a gossip or trifler in talk). KJV: babbler.

σπευδω.def: probably strengthened from πούς (G4228); to "speed" ("study"), i.e. urge on (diligently or earnestly); by implication, to await eagerly. KJV: (make, with) haste unto.

σπηλαιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of σπέος (a grotto); a cavern; by implication, a hiding-place or resort. KJV: cave, den.

σπιλασ.def: of uncertain derivation; a ledge or reef of rock in the sea. KJV: spot (by confusion with σπίλος (G4696)).

σπιλοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; a stain or blemish, i.e. (figuratively) defect, disgrace. KJV: spot.

σπιλοω.def: from σπίλος (G4696); to stain or soil (literally or figuratively). KJV: defile, spot.

σπλαγχνιζομαι.def: middle voice from σπλάγχνον (G4698); to have the bowels yearn, i.e. (figuratively) feel sympathy, to pity. KJV: have (be moved with) compassion.

σπλαγχνον.def: probably strengthened from σπλήν (the "spleen"); an intestine (plural); figuratively, pity or sympathy. KJV: bowels, inward affection, + tender mercy.

σπογγοσ.def: perhaps of foreign origin; a "sponge". KJV: spunge.

σποδοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; ashes. KJV: ashes.

σπορα.def: from σπείρω (G4687); a sowing, i.e. (by implication) parentage. KJV: seed.

σποριμοσ.def: from σπόρος (G4703); sown, i.e. (neuter plural) a planted field. KJV: corn(-field).

σποροσ.def: from σπείρω (G4687); a scattering (of seed), i.e. (concretely) seed (as sown). KJV: seed (X sown).

σπουδαζω.def: from σπουδή (G4710); to use speed, i.e. to make effort, be prompt or earnest. KJV: do (give) diligence, be diligent (forward), endeavour, labour, study.

σπουδαιοσ.def: from σπουδή (G4710); prompt, energetic, earnest. KJV: diligent.

σπουδαιοτερον.def: neuter of σπουδαιότερος (G4707) as adverb; more earnestly than others), i.e. very promptly. KJV: very diligently.

σπουδαιοτεροσ.def: comparative of σπουδαῖος (G4705); more prompt, more earnest. KJV: more diligent (forward).

σπουδαιοτερωσ.def: adverb from σπουδαιότερος (G4707); more speedily, i.e. sooner than otherwise. KJV: more carefully.

σπουδαιωσ.def: adverb from σπουδαῖος (G4705); earnestly, promptly. KJV: diligently, instantly.

σπουδη.def: from σπεύδω (G4692); "speed", i.e. (by implication) despatch, eagerness, earnestness. KJV: business, (earnest) care(-fulness), diligence, forwardness, haste.

σπυρισ.def: from σπείρω (G4687) (as woven); a hamper or lunch-receptacle. KJV: basket.

σταδιον.def: from the base of ἵστημι (G2476) (as fixed); a stade or certain measure of distance; by implication, a stadium or race-course. KJV: furlong, race.

σταμνοσ.def: from the base of ἵστημι (G2476) (as stationary); a jar or earthen tank. KJV: pot.

στασισ.def: from the base of ἵστημι (G2476); a standing (properly, the act), i.e. (by analogy) position (existence); by implication, a popular uprising; figuratively, controversy. KJV: dissension, insurrection, X standing, uproar.

στατηρ.def: from the base of καύχησις (G2746); a stander (standard of value), i.e. (specially), a stater or certain coin. KJV: piece of money.

σταυροσ.def: from the base of ἵστημι (G2476); a stake or post (as set upright), i.e. (specially), a pole or cross (as an instrument of capital punishment); figuratively, exposure to death, i.e. self-denial; by implication, the atonement of Christ. KJV: cross.

σταυροω.def: from σταυρός (G4716); to impale on the cross; figuratively, to extinguish (subdue) passion or selfishness. KJV: crucify.

σταφυλη.def: probably from the base of στέφανος (G4735); a cluster of grapes (as if intertwined). KJV: grapes.

σταχυσ.def: from the base of ἵστημι (G2476); a head of grain (as standing out from the stalk). KJV: ear (of corn).
the same as στάχυς (G4719); Stachys, a Christian. KJV: Stachys.

στεγη.def: strengthened from a primary τέγος (a "thatch" or "deck" of a building); a roof. KJV: roof.

στεγω.def: from στέγη (G4721); to roof over, i.e. (figuratively) to cover with silence (endure patiently). KJV: (for-)bear, suffer.

στειροσ.def: a contraction from στερεός (G4731) (as stiff and unnatural); "sterile". KJV: barren.

στελλω.def: probably strengthened from the base of ἵστημι (G2476); properly, to set fast ("stall"), i.e. (figuratively) to repress (reflexively, abstain from associating with). KJV: avoid, withdraw self.

στεμμα.def: from the base of στέφανος (G4735); a wreath for show. KJV: garland.

στεναγμοσ.def: from στενάζω (G4727); a sigh. KJV: groaning.

στεναζω.def: from στενός (G4728); to make (intransitively, be) in straits, i.e. (by implication) to sigh, murmur, pray inaudibly. KJV: with grief, groan, grudge, sigh.

στενοσ.def: probably from the base of ἵστημι (G2476); narrow (from obstacles standing close about). KJV: strait.

στενοχωρεω.def: from the same as στενοχωρία (G4730); to hem in closely, i.e. (figuratively) cramp. KJV: distress, straiten.

στενοχωρια.def: from a compound of στενός (G4728) and χώρα (G5561); narrowness of room, i.e. (figuratively) calamity. KJV: anguish, distress.

στερεοσ.def: from ἵστημι (G2476); stiff, i.e. solid, stable (literally or figuratively). KJV: stedfast, strong, sure.

στερεοω.def: from στερεός (G4731); to solidify, i.e. confirm (literally or figuratively). KJV: establish, receive strength, make strong.

στερεωμα.def: from στερεόω (G4732); something established, i.e. (abstractly) confirmation (stability). KJV: stedfastness.

στεφανασ.def: probably contraction for στεφανωτός (crowned; from στεφανόω (G4737)); Stephanas, a Christian. KJV: Stephanas.

στεφανοσ.def: from an apparently primary στέφω (to twine or wreathe); a chaplet (as a badge of royalty, a prize in the public games or a symbol of honor generally; but more conspicuous and elaborate than the simple fillet, διάδημα (G1238)), literally or figuratively. KJV: crown.
the same as στέφανος (G4735); Stephanus, a Christian. KJV: Stephen.

στεφανοω.def: from στέφανος (G4735); to adorn with an honorary wreath (literally or figuratively). KJV: crown.

στηθοσ.def: from ἵστημι (G2476) (as standing prominently); the (entire external) bosom, i.e. chest. KJV: breast.

στηκω.def: from the perfect tense of ἵστημι (G2476); to be stationary, i.e. (figuratively) to persevere. KJV: stand (fast).

στηριζω.def: from a presumed derivative of ἵστημι (G2476) (like στερεός (G4731)); to set fast, i.e. (literally) to turn resolutely in a certain direction, or (figuratively) to confirm. KJV: fix, (e-)stablish, stedfastly set, strengthen.

στιγμα.def: from a primary στίζω (to "stick", i.e. prick); a mark incised or punched (for recognition of ownership), i.e. (figuratively) scar of service. KJV: mark.

στιγμη.def: feminine of στίγμα (G4742); a point of time, i.e. an instant. KJV: moment.

στιλβω.def: apparently a primary verb; to gleam, i.e. flash intensely. KJV: shining.

στοα.def: probably from ἵστημι (G2476); a colonnade or interior piazza. KJV: porch.

στοιβασ.def: from a primary στείβω (to "step" or "stamp"); a spread (as if tramped flat) of loose materials for a couch, i.e. (by implication) a bough of a tree so employed. KJV: branch.

στοιχειον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of στοιχέω (G4748); something orderly in arrangement, i.e. (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively). KJV: element, principle, rudiment.

στοιχεω.def: from a derivative of στείχω (to range in regular line); to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e. (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety. KJV: walk (orderly).

στολη.def: from στέλλω (G4724); equipment, i.e. (specially), a "stole" or long-fitting gown (as a mark of dignity). KJV: long clothing (garment), (long) robe.

στομα.def: probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of τομώτερος (G5114); the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon). KJV: edge, face, mouth.

στομαχοσ.def: from στόμα (G4750); an orifice (the gullet), i.e. (specially), the "stomach". KJV: stomach.

στρατεια.def: from στρατεύομαι (G4754); military service, i.e. (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger). KJV: warfare.

στρατευμα.def: from στρατεύομαι (G4754); an armament, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic). KJV: army, soldier, man of war.

στρατευομαι.def: middle voice from the base of στρατιά (G4756); to serve in a military campaign; figuratively, to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations. KJV: soldier, (go to) war(-fare).

στρατηγοσ.def: from the base of στρατιά (G4756) and ἄγω (G71) or ἡγέομαι (G2233); a general, i.e. (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (prætor), the chief (præfect) of the (Levitical) temple-wardens. KJV: captain, magistrate.

στρατια.def: feminine of a derivative of στρατός (an army; from the base of στρώννυμι (G4766), as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e. an army, i.e. (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries. KJV: host.

στρατιωτησ.def: from a presumed derivative of the same as στρατιά (G4756); a camper-out, i.e. a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively). KJV: soldier.

στρατολογεω.def: from a compound of the base of στρατιά (G4756) and λέγω (G3004) (in its original sense); to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army. KJV: choose to be a soldier.

στρατοπεδαρχησ.def: from στρατόπεδον (G4760) and ἄρχω (G757); a ruler of an army, i.e. (specially), a Prætorian præfect. KJV: captain of the guard.

στρατοπεδον.def: from the base of στρατιά (G4756) and the same as πεδινός (G3977); a camping-ground, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops. KJV: army.

στρεβλοω.def: from a derivative of στρέφω (G4762); to wrench, i.e. (specially), to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively, to pervert. KJV: wrest.

στρεφω.def: strengthened from the base of τροπή (G5157); to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively). KJV: convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about).

στρηνιαω.def: from a presumed derivative of στρῆνος (G4764); to be luxurious. KJV: live deliciously.

στρηνοσ.def: akin to στερεός (G4731); a "straining", "strenuousness" or "strength", i.e. (figuratively) luxury (voluptuousness). KJV: delicacy.

στρουθιον.def: diminutive of στρουθός (a sparrow); a little sparrow. KJV: sparrow.

στρωννυμι.def: prolongation from a still simpler στρόω, (used only as an alternate in certain tenses) (probably akin to στερεός (G4731) through the idea of positing); to "strew," i.e. spread (as a carpet or couch). KJV: make bed, furnish, spread, strew.

στυγναζω.def: from the same as στυγνητός (G4767); to render gloomy, i.e. (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech). KJV: lower, be sad.

στυγνητοσ.def: from a derivative of an obsolete apparently primary στύγω (to hate); hated, i.e. odious. KJV: hateful.

στυλοσ.def: from στύω (to stiffen; properly akin to the base of ἵστημι (G2476)); a post ("style"), i.e. (figuratively) support. KJV: pillar.

στωικοσ.def: from στοά (G4745); a "Stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), i.e. adherent of a certin philosophy. KJV: Stoick.

συ.def: the personal pronoun of the second person singular; thou. KJV: thou.

συγγενεια.def: from συγγενής (G4773); relationship, i.e. (concretely) relatives. KJV: kindred.

συγγενησ.def: from σύν (G4862) and γένος (G1085); a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman. KJV: cousin, kin(-sfolk, -sman).

συγγνωμη.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and γινώσκω (G1097); fellow knowledge, i.e. concession. KJV: permission.

συγκαθημαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and κάθημαι (G2521); to seat oneself in company with. KJV: sit with.

συγκαθιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and καθίζω (G2523); to give (or take) a seat in company with. KJV: (make) sit (down) together.

συγκακοπαθεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κακοπαθέω (G2553); to suffer hardship in company with. KJV: be partaker of afflictions.

συγκακουχεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κακουχέω (G2558); to maltreat in company with, i.e. (passively) endure persecution together. KJV: suffer affliction with.

συγκαλεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and καλέω (G2564); to convoke. KJV: call together.

συγκαλυπτω.def: from σύν (G4862) and καλύπτω (G2572); to conceal altogether. KJV: cover.

συγκαμπτω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κάμπτω (G2578); to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict. KJV: bow down.

συγκαταβαινω.def: from σύν (G4862) and καταβαίνω (G2597); to descend in company with. KJV: go down with.

συγκαταθεσισ.def: from συγκατατίθεμαι (G4784); a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with. KJV: agreement.

συγκατατιθεμαι.def: middle from σύν (G4862) and κατατίθημι (G2698); to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to accord with. KJV: consent.

συγκαταψηφιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a compound of κατά (G2596) and ψηφίζω (G5585); to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among. KJV: number with.

συγκεραννυμι.def: from σύν (G4862) and κεράννυμι (G2767); to commingle, i.e. (figuratively) to combine or assimilate. KJV: mix with, temper together.

συγκινεω.def: from σπαράσσω (G4682) and κινέω (G2795); to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition). KJV: stir up.

συγκλειω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κλείω (G2808); to shut together, i.e. include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to. KJV: conclude, inclose, shut up.

συγκληρονομοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and κληρονόμος (G2818); a co-heir, i.e. (by analogy) participant in common. KJV: fellow (joint)-heir, heir together, heir with.

συγκοινωνεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κοινωνέω (G2841); to share in company with, i.e. co-participate in. KJV: communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of.

συγκοινωνοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and κοινωνός (G2844); a co-participant. KJV: companion, partake(-r, -r with).

συγκομιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κομίζω (G2865); to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others. KJV: carry.

συγκρινω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κρίνω (G2919); to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e. combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance). KJV: compare among (with).

συγκυπτω.def: from σύν (G4862) and κύπτω (G2955); to stoop altogether, i.e. be completely overcome by. KJV: bow together.

συγκυρια.def: from a comparative of σύν (G4862) and κυρέω (to light or happen; from the base of κύριος (G2962)); concurrence, i.e. accident. KJV: chance.

συγχαιρω.def: from σύν (G4862) and χαίρω (G5463); to sympathize in gladness, congratulate. KJV: rejoice in (with).

συγχεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and χέω (to pour) or its alternate; to commingle promiscuously, i.e. (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind). KJV: confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar.

συγχραομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and χράομαι (G5530); to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common. KJV: have dealings with.

συγχυσισ.def: from συγχέω (G4797); commixture, i.e. (figuratively) riotous disturbance. KJV: confusion.

συζαω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ζάω (G2198); to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively). KJV: live with.

συζευγνυμι.def: from σύν (G4862) and the base of ζεῦγος (G2201); to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage). KJV: join together.

συζητεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ζητέω (G2212); to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil. KJV: dispute (with), enquire, question (with), reason (together).

συζητησισ.def: from συζητέω (G4802); mutual questioning, i.e. discussion. KJV: disputation(-ting), reasoning.

συζητητησ.def: from συζητέω (G4802); a disputant, i.e. sophist. KJV: disputer.

συζυγοσ.def: from συζεύγνυμι (G4801); co-yoked, i.e. (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; Syzygus, a Christian. KJV: yokefellow.

συζωοποιεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ζωοποιέω (G2227); to reanimate conjointly with (figuratively). KJV: quicken together with.

συκαμινοσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8256) in imitation of συκομωραία (G4809); a sycamore-fig tree. KJV: sycamine tree.

συκη.def: from σῦκον (G4810); a fig-tree. KJV: fig tree.

συκομωραια.def: from σῦκον (G4810) and μόρον (the mulberry); the "sycamore"-fig tree. KJV: sycamore tree.

συκον.def: apparently a primary word; a fig. KJV: fig.

συκοφαντεω.def: from a compound of σῦκον (G4810) and a derivative of φαίνω (G5316); to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from Greece), "sycophant", i.e. (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort). KJV: accuse falsely, take by false accusation.

συλαγωγεω.def: from the base of συλάω (G4813) and (the reduplicated form of) ἄγω (G71); to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce. KJV: spoil.

συλαω.def: from a derivative of σύλλω (to strip; probably akin to αἱρέομαι (G138); compare σκῦλον (G4661)); to despoil. KJV: rob.

συλλαλεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and λαλέω (G2980); to talk together, i.e. converse. KJV: commune (confer, talk) with, speak among.

συλλαμβανω.def: from σύν (G4862) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to clasp, i.e. seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid. KJV: catch, conceive, help, take.

συλλεγω.def: from σύν (G4862) and λέγω (G3004) in its original sense; to collect. KJV: gather (together, up).

συλλογιζομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and λογίζομαι (G3049); to reckon together (with oneself), i.e. deliberate. KJV: reason with.

συλλυπεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and λυπέω (G3076); to afflict jointly, i.e. (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone. KJV: be grieved.

συμβαινω.def: from σύν (G4862) and the base of βάσις (G939); to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place). KJV: be(-fall), happen (unto).

συμβαλλω.def: from σύν (G4862) and βάλλω (G906); to combine, i.e. (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack. KJV: confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder.

συμβασιλευω.def: from σύν (G4862) and βασιλεύω (G936); to be co-regent (figuratively). KJV: reign with.

συμβιβαζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and βιβάζω (to force; causative (by reduplication) of the base of βάσις (G939)); to drive together, i.e. unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach. KJV: compact, assuredly gather, intrust, knit together, prove.

συμβουλευω.def: from σύν (G4862) and βουλεύω (G1011); to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e. recommend, deliberate or determine. KJV: consult, (give, take) counsel (together).

συμβουλιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of σύμβουλος (G4825); advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e. the provincial assessors or lay-court. KJV: consultation, counsel, council.

συμβουλοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and βουλή (G1012); a consultor, i.e. adviser. KJV: counsellor.

συμεων.def: from the same as Σίμων (G4613); Symeon (i.e. Shimon), the name of five Israelites. KJV: Simeon, Simon.

συμμαθητησ.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and μανθάνω (G3129); a co-learner (of Christianity). KJV: fellow disciple.

συμμαρτυρεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and μαρτυρέω (G3140); to testify jointly, i.e. corroborate by (concurrent) evidence. KJV: testify unto, (also) bear witness (with).

συμμεριζομαι.def: middle voice from σύν (G4862) and μερίζω (G3307); to share jointly, i.e. participate in. KJV: be partaker with.

συμμετοχοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and μέτοχος (G3353); a co-participant. KJV: partaker.

συμμιμητησ.def: from a presumed compound of σύν (G4862) and μιμέομαι (G3401); a co-imitator, i.e. fellow votary. KJV: follower together.

συμμορφοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and μορφή (G3444); jointly formed, i.e. (figuratively) similar. KJV: conformed to, fashioned like unto.

συμμορφοω.def: from σύμμορφος (G4832); to render like, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate. KJV: make conformable unto.

συμπαθεω.def: from συμπαθής (G4835); to feel "sympathy" with, i.e. (by implication) to commiserate. KJV: have compassion, be touched with a feeling of.

συμπαθησ.def: from συμπάσχω (G4841); having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e. (by implication) mutually commiserative. KJV: having compassion one of another.

συμπαραγινομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and παραγίνομαι (G3854); to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid. KJV: come together, stand with.

συμπαρακαλεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and παρακαλέω (G3870); to console jointly. KJV: comfort together.

συμπαραλαμβανω.def: from σύν (G4862) and παραλαμβάνω (G3880); to take along in company. KJV: take with.

συμπαραμενω.def: from σύν (G4862) and παραμένω (G3887); to remain in company, i.e. still live. KJV: continue with.

συμπαρειμι.def: from σύν (G4862) and πάρειμι (G3918); to be at hand together, i.e. now present. KJV: be here present with.

συμπασχω.def: from σύν (G4862) and πάσχω (G3958) (including its alternate); to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize"). KJV: suffer with.

συμπεμπω.def: from σύν (G4862) and πέμπω (G3992); to despatch in company. KJV: send with.

συμπεριλαμβανω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a compound of περί (G4012) and λαμβάνω (G2983); to take by enclosing altogether, i.e. earnestly throw the arms about one. KJV: embrace.

συμπινω.def: from σύν (G4862) and πίνω (G4095); to partake a beverage in company. KJV: drink with.

συμπληροω.def: from σύν (G4862) and πληρόω (G4137); to implenish completely, i.e. (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete). KJV: (fully) come, fill up.

συμπνιγω.def: from σύν (G4862) and πνίγω (G4155); to strangle completely, i.e. (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd. KJV: choke, throng.

συμπολιτησ.def: from σύν (G4862) and πολίτης (G4177); a native of the same town, i.e. (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-Christian). KJV: fellow- citizen.

συμπορευομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and πορεύομαι (G4198); to journey together; by implication, to assemble. KJV: go with, resort.

συμποσιον.def: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of συμπίνω (G4844); a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests. KJV: company.

συμπρεσβυτεροσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and πρεσβύτερος (G4245); a co-presbyter. KJV: presbyter, also an elder.

συμφερω.def: from σύν (G4862) and φέρω (G5342) (including its alternate); to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage. KJV: be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for).

συμφημι.def: from σύν (G4862) and φημί (G5346); to say jointly, i.e. assent to. KJV: consent unto.

συμφυλετησ.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of φυλή (G5443); a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country. KJV: countryman.

συμφυτοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of φύω (G5453); grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to. KJV: planted together.

συμφυω.def: from σύν (G4862) and φύω (G5453); passive, to grow jointly. KJV: spring up with.

συμφωνεω.def: from σύμφωνος (G4859); to be harmonious, i.e. (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact). KJV: agree (together, with).

συμφωνια.def: from σύμφωνος (G4859); unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e. a concert of instruments (harmonious note). KJV: music.

συμφωνοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and φωνή (G5456); sounding together (alike), i.e. (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement). KJV: consent.

συμψηφιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ψηφίζω (G5585); to compute jointly. KJV: reckon.

συμψυχοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and ψυχή (G5590); co-spirited, i.e. similar in sentiment. KJV: like-minded.

συν.def: a primary preposition denoting union; with or together (but much closer than μετά (G3326) or παρά (G3844)), i.e. by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc. KJV: beside, with.

συναγω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἄγω (G71); to lead together, i.e. collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably). KJV: + accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in.

συναγωγη.def: from (the reduplicated form of) συνάγω (G4863); an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church. KJV: assembly, congregation, synagogue.

συναγωνιζομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀγωνίζομαι (G75); to struggle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant). KJV: strive together with.

συναθλεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀθλέω (G118); to wrestle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to seek jointly. KJV: labour with, strive together for.

συναθροιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀθροίζω (to hoard); to convene. KJV: call (gather) together.

συναιρω.def: from σύν (G4862) and αἴρω (G142); to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account). KJV: reckon, take.

συναιχμαλωτοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and αἰχμάλωτος (G164); a co-captive. KJV: fellowprisoner.

συνακολουθεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀκολουθέω (G190); to accompany. KJV: follow.

συναλιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἁλίζω (to throng); to accumulate, i.e. convene. KJV: assemble together.

συναναβαινω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀναβαίνω (G305); to ascend in company with. KJV: come up with.

συνανακειμαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀνακεῖμαι (G345); to recline in company with (at a meal). KJV: sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat).

συναναμιγνυμι.def: from σύν (G4862) and a compound of ἀνά (G303) and μίγνυμι (G3396); to mix up together, i.e. (figurative) associate with. KJV: (have, keep) company (with).

συναναπαυομαι.def: middle from σύν (G4862) and ἀναπαύω (G373); to recruit oneself in company with. KJV: refresh with.

συνανταω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of ἀντί (G473); to meet with; figuratively, to occur. KJV: befall, meet.

συναντησισ.def: from συναντάω (G4876); a meeting with. KJV: meet.

συναντιλαμβανομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀντιλαμβάνομαι (G482); to take hold of opposite together, i.e. co-operate (assist). KJV: help.

συναπαγω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀπάγω (G520); to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield). KJV: carry (lead) away with, condescend.

συναποθνησκω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀποθνήσκω (G599); to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to. KJV: be dead (die) with.

συναπολλυμι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀπόλλυμι (G622); to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with. KJV: perish with.

συναποστελλω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἀποστέλλω (G649); to despatch (on an errand) in company with. KJV: send with.

συναρμολογεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of a compound of ἁρμός (G719) and λέγω (G3004) (in its original sense of laying); to render close-jointed together, i.e. organize compactly. KJV: be fitly framed (joined) together.

συναρπαζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἁρπάζω (G726); to snatch together, i.e. seize. KJV: catch.

συναυξανω.def: from σύν (G4862) and αὐξάνω (G837); to increase (grow up) together. KJV: grow together.

συνδεσμοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and δεσμόν (G1199); a joint tie, i.e. ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control. KJV: band, bond.

συνδεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and δέω (G1210); to bind with, i.e. (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively). KJV: be bound with.

συνδοξαζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and δοξάζω (G1392); to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with. KJV: glorify together.

συνδουλοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and δοῦλος (G1401); a co-slave, i.e. servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine). KJV: fellowservant.

συνδρομη.def: from (the alternate of) συντρέχω (G4936); a running together, i.e. (riotous) concourse. KJV: run together.

συνεγειρω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἐγείρω (G1453); to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to. KJV: raise up together, rise with.

συνεδριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of σύν (G4862) and the base of ἑδραῖος (G1476); a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal. KJV: council.

συνειδησισ.def: from a prolonged form of συνείδω (G4894); co-perception, i.e. moral consciousness. KJV: conscience.

συνειδω.def: from σύν (G4862) and εἴδω (G1492); to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of. KJV: consider, know, be privy, be ware of.

συνειμι.def: from σύν (G4862) and εἰμί (G1510) (including its various inflections); to be in company with, i.e. present at the time. KJV: be with.
from σύν (G4862) and εἶμι (to go); to assemble. KJV: gather together.

συνεισερχομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and εἰσέρχομαι (G1525); to enter in company with. KJV: go in with, go with into.

συνεκδημοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and the base of ἐκδημέω (G1553); a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller. KJV: companion in travel, travel with.

συνεκλεκτοσ.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and ἐκλέγομαι (G1586); chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian). KJV: elected together with.

συνελαυνω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἐλαύνω (G1643); to drive together, i.e. (figuratively) exhort (to reconciliation). KJV: + set at one again.

συνεπιμαρτυρεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἐπιμαρτυρέω (G1957); to testify further jointly, i.e. unite in adding evidence. KJV: also bear witness.

συνεπομαι.def: middle voice from σύν (G4862) and a primary ἕπω (to follow); to attend (travel) in company with. KJV: accompany.

συνεργεω.def: from συνεργός (G4904); to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate. KJV: help (work) with, work(-er) together.

συνεργοσ.def: from a presumed compound of σύν (G4862) and the base of ἔργον (G2041); a co-laborer, i.e. coadjutor. KJV: companion in labour, (fellow-)helper(-labourer, -worker), labourer together with, workfellow.

συνερχομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἔρχομαι (G2064); to convene, depart in company with, associate with, or (specially), cohabit (conjugally). KJV: accompany, assemble (with), come (together), come (company, go) with, resort.

συνεσθιω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἐσθίω (G2068) (including its alternate); to take food in company with. KJV: eat with.

συνεσισ.def: from συνίημι (G4920); a mental putting together, i.e. intelligence or (concretely) the intellect. KJV: knowledge, understanding.

συνετοσ.def: from συνίημι (G4920); mentally put (or putting) together, i.e. sagacious. KJV: prudent.

συνευδοκεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and εὐδοκέω (G2106); to think well of in common, i.e. assent to, feel gratified with. KJV: allow, assent, be pleased, have pleasure.

συνευωχεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of a presumed compound of εὖ (G2095) and a derivative of ἔχω (G2192) (meaning to be in good condition, i.e. (by implication) to fare well, or feast); to entertain sumptuously in company with, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to revel together. KJV: feast with.

συνεφιστημι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἐφίστημι (G2186); to stand up together, i.e. to resist (or assault) jointly. KJV: rise up together.

συνεχω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἔχω (G2192); to hold together, i.e. to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively, to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy. KJV: constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng.

συνηδομαι.def: middle voice from σύν (G4862) and the base of ἡδονή (G2237); to rejoice in with oneself, i.e. feel satisfaction concerning. KJV: delight.

συνηθεια.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and ἦθος (G2239); mutual habituation, i.e. usage. KJV: custom.

συνηλικιωτησ.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of ἡλικία (G2244); a co-aged person, i.e. alike in years. KJV: equal.

συνθαπτω.def: from σύν (G4862) and θάπτω (G2290); to inter in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate spiritually (to Christ by a sepulture as to sin). KJV: bury with.

συνθλαω.def: from σύν (G4862) and thlao (to crush); to dash together, i.e. shatter. KJV: break.

συνθλιβω.def: from σύν (G4862) and θλίβω (G2346); to compress, i.e. crowd on all sides. KJV: throng.

συνθρυπτω.def: from σύν (G4862) and θρύπτω (to crumble); to crush together, i.e. (figuratively) to dispirit. KJV: break.

συνιημι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἵημι (to send); to put together, i.e. (mentally) to comprehend; by implication, to act piously. KJV: consider, understand, be wise.

συνισταω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ἵστημι (G2476) (including its collateral forms); to set together, i.e. (by implication) to introduce (favorably), or (figuratively) to exhibit; intransitively, to stand near, or (figuratively) to constitute. KJV: approve, commend, consist, make, stand (with).

συνοδευω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ὁδεύω (G3593); to travel in company with. KJV: journey with.

συνοδια.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and ὁδός (G3598) ("synod"); companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan. KJV: company.

συνοικεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and οἰκέω (G3611); to reside together (as a family). KJV: dwell together.

συνοικοδομεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and οἰκοδομέω (G3618); to construct, i.e. (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively). KJV: build together.

συνομιλεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ὁμιλέω (G3656); to converse mutually. KJV: talk with.

συνομορεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of a compound of the base of 3674 and the base of ὅριον (G3725); to border together, i.e. adjoin. KJV: join hard.

συνοχη.def: from συνέχω (G4912); restraint, i.e. (figuratively) anxiety. KJV: anguish, distress.

συντασσω.def: from σύν (G4862) and τάσσω (G5021); to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct. KJV: appoint.

συντελεια.def: from συντελέω (G4931); entire completion, i.e. consummation (of a dispensation). KJV: end.

συντελεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and τελέω (G5055); to complete entirely; generally, to execute (literally or figuratively). KJV: end, finish, fulfil, make.

συντεμνω.def: from σύν (G4862) and the base of τομώτερος (G5114); to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily). KJV: (cut) short.

συντηρεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and τηρέω (G5083); to keep closely together, i.e. (by implication) to conserve (from ruin); mentally, to remember (and obey). KJV: keep, observe, preserve.

συντιθεμαι.def: middle voice from σύν (G4862) and τίθημι (G5087); to place jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to consent (bargain, stipulate), concur. KJV: agree, assent, covenant.

συντομωσ.def: adverb from a derivative of συντέμνω (G4932); concisely (briefly). KJV: a few words.

συντρεχω.def: from σύν (G4862) and τρέχω (G5143) (including its alternate); to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively). KJV: run (together, with).

συντριβω.def: from σύν (G4862) and the base of τρίβος (G5147); to crush completely, i.e. to shatter (literally or figuratively). KJV: break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise.

συντριμμα.def: from συντρίβω (G4937); concussion or utter fracture (properly, concretely), i.e. complete ruin. KJV: destruction.

συντροφοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and τροφός (G5162) (in a passive sense); a fellow-nursling, i.e. comrade. KJV: brought up with.

συντυγχανω.def: from σύν (G4862) and τυγχάνω (G5177); to chance together, i.e. meet with (reach). KJV: come at.

συντυχη.def: from συντυγχάνω (G4940); an accident; Syntyche, a Christian female. KJV: Syntyche.

συνυποκρινομαι.def: from σύν (G4862) and ὑποκρίνομαι (G5271); to act hypocritically in concert with. KJV: dissemble with.

συνυπουργεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of a compound of ὑπό (G5259) and the base of ἔργον (G2041); to be a co-auxiliary, i.e. assist. KJV: help together.

συνωδινω.def: from σύν (G4862) and ὠδίνω (G5605); to have (parturition) pangs in company (concert, simultaneously) with, i.e. (figuratively) to sympathize (in expectation of relief from suffering). KJV: travail in pain together.

συνωμοσια.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and ὀμνύω (G3660); a swearing together, i.e. (by implication) a plot. KJV: comspiracy.

συρακουσαι.def: plural of uncertain derivation; Syracuse, the capital of Sicily. KJV: Syracuse.

συρια.def: probably of Hebrew origin (H6865); Syria (i.e. Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia. KJV: Syria.

συροσ.def: from the same as Συρία (G4947); a Syran (i.e. probably Tyrian), a native of Syria. KJV: Syrian.

συροφοινισσα.def: feminine of a compound of Σύρος (G4948) and the same as Φοινίκη (G5403); a Syro-phœnician woman, i.e. a female native of Phœnicia in Syria. KJV: Syrophenician.

συρτισ.def: from σύρω (G4951); a shoal (from the sand drawn thither by the waves), i.e. the Syrtis Major or great bay on the north coast of Africa. KJV: quicksands.

συρω.def: probably akin to αἱρέομαι (G138); to trail. KJV: drag, draw, hale.

συσπαρασσω.def: from σύν (G4862) and σπαράσσω (G4682); to rend completely, i.e. (by analogy) to convulse violently. KJV: throw down.

συσσημον.def: neuter of a compound of σύν (G4862) and the base of σημαίνω (G4591); a sign in common, i.e. preconcerted signal. KJV: token.

συσσωμοσ.def: from σύν (G4862) and σῶμα (G4983); of a joint body, i.e. (figuratively) a fellow-member of the Christian community. KJV: of the same body.

συστασιαστησ.def: from a compound of σύν (G4862) and a derivative of στάσις (G4714); a fellow-insurgent. KJV: make insurrection with.

συστατικοσ.def: from a derivative of συνιστάω (G4921); introductory, i.e. recommendatory. KJV: of commendation.

συσταυροω.def: from σύν (G4862) and σταυρόω (G4717); to impale in company with (literally or figuratively). KJV: crucify with.

συστελλω.def: from σύν (G4862) and στέλλω (G4724); to send (draw) together, i.e. enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval). KJV: short, wind up.

συστεναζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and στενάζω (G4727); to moan jointly, i.e. (figuratively) experience a common calamity. KJV: groan together.

συστοιχεω.def: from σύν (G4862) and στοιχέω (G4748); to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to. KJV: answer to.

συστρατιωτησ.def: from σύν (G4862) and στρατιώτης (G4757); a co-campaigner, i.e. (figuratively) an associate in Christian toil. KJV: fellowsoldier.

συστρεφω.def: from σύν (G4862) and στρέφω (G4762); to twist together, i.e. collect (a bundle, a crowd). KJV: gather.

συστροφη.def: from συστρέφω (G4962); a twisting together, i.e. (figuratively) a secret coalition, riotous crowd. KJV: + band together, concourse.

συσχηματιζω.def: from σύν (G4862) and a derivative of σχῆμα (G4976); to fashion alike, i.e. conform to the same pattern (figuratively). KJV: conform to, fashion self according to.

συχαρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7941); Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine. KJV: Sychar.

συχεμ.def: of Hebrew origin (H7927); Sychem (i.e. Shekem), the name of a Canaanite and of a place in Palestine. KJV: Sychem.

σφαγη.def: from σφάζω (G4969); butchery (of animals for food or sacrifice, or (figuratively) of men (destruction)). KJV: slaughter.

σφαγιον.def: neuter of a derivative of σφαγή (G4967); a victim (in sacrifice). KJV: slain beast.

σφαζω.def: a primary verb; to butcher (especially an animal for food or in sacrifice) or (generally) to slaughter, or (specially), to maim (violently). KJV: kill, slay, wound.

σφοδρα.def: neuter plural of σφοδρός (violent; of uncertain derivation) as adverb; vehemently, i.e. in a high degree, much. KJV: exceeding(-ly), greatly, sore, very.

σφοδρωσ.def: adverb from the same as σφόδρα (G4970); very much. KJV: exceedingly.

σφραγιζω.def: from σφραγίς (G4973); to stamp (with a signet or private mark) for security or preservation (literally or figuratively); by implication, to keep secret, to attest. KJV: (set a, set to) seal up, stop.

σφραγισ.def: probably strengthened from φράσσω (G5420); a signet (as fencing in or protecting from misappropriation); by implication, the stamp impressed (as a mark of privacy, or genuineness), literally or figuratively. KJV: seal.

σφυρον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative probably of the same as σφαῖρα (a ball, "sphere"; compare the feminine σφῦρα, a hammer); the ankle (as globular). KJV: ancle bone.

σχεδον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the alternate of ἔχω (G2192) as adverb; nigh, i.e. nearly. KJV: almost.

σχημα.def: from the alternate of ἔχω (G2192); a figure (as a mode or circumstance), i.e. (by implication) external condition. KJV: fashion.

σχιζω.def: apparently a primary verb; to split or sever (literally or figuratively). KJV: break, divide, open, rend, make a rent.

σχισμα.def: from σχίζω (G4977); a split or gap ("schism"), literally or figuratively. KJV: division, rent, schism.

σχοινιον.def: diminutive of σχοῖνος (a rush or flag-plant; of uncertain derivation); a rushlet, i.e. grass-withe or tie (generally). KJV: small cord, rope.

σχολαζω.def: from σχολή (G4981); to take a holiday, i.e. be at leisure for (by implication, devote oneself wholly to); figuratively, to be vacant (of a house). KJV: empty, give self.

σχολη.def: probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of ἔχω (G2192); properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment). KJV: school.

σωζω.def: from a primary σῶς (contraction for obsolete σάος, "safe"); to save, i.e. deliver or protect (literally or figuratively). KJV: heal, preserve, save (self), do well, be (make) whole.

σωμα.def: from σώζω (G4982); the body (as a sound whole), used in a very wide application, literally or figuratively. KJV: bodily, body, slave.

σωματικοσ.def: from σῶμα (G4983); corporeal or physical. KJV: bodily.

σωματικωσ.def: adverb from σωματικός (G4984); corporeally or physically. KJV: bodily.

σωπατροσ.def: from the base of σώζω (G4982) and πατήρ (G3962); of a safe father; Sopatrus, a Christian. KJV: Sopater.

σωρευω.def: from another form of σορός (G4673); to pile up (literally or figuratively). KJV: heap, load.

σωσθενησ.def: from the base of σώζω (G4982) and that of σθενόω (G4599); of safe strength; Sosthenes, a Christian. KJV: Sosthenes.

σωσιπατροσ.def: prolongation for Σώπατρος (G4986); Sosipatrus, a Christian. KJV: Sosipater.

σωτηρ.def: from σώζω (G4982); a deliverer, i.e. God or Christ. KJV: saviour.

σωτηρια.def: feminine of a derivative of σωτήρ (G4990) as (properly, abstract) noun; rescue or safety (physically or morally). KJV: deliver, health, salvation, save, saving.

σωτηριον.def: neuter of the same as σωτηρία (G4991) as (properly, concretely) noun; defender or (by implication) defence. KJV: salvation.

σωφρονεω.def: from σώφρων (G4998); to be of sound mind, i.e. sane, (figuratively) moderate. KJV: be in right mind, be sober (minded), soberly.

σωφρονιζω.def: from σώφρων (G4998); to make of sound mind, i.e. (figuratively) to discipline or correct. KJV: teach to be sober.

σωφρονισμοσ.def: from σωφρονίζω (G4994); discipline, i.e. self-control. KJV: sound mind.

σωφρονωσ.def: adverb from σώφρων (G4998); with sound mind, i.e. moderately. KJV: soberly.

σωφροσυνη.def: from σώφρων (G4998); soundness of mind, i.e. (literally) sanity or (figuratively) self-control. KJV: soberness, sobriety.

σωφρων.def: from the base of σώζω (G4982) and that of φρήν (G5424); safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion). KJV: discreet, sober, temperate.
